for little D

To my little D,

I don't know how to start this so I'm just gonna write.

I still can't forget you. Like, not in a dramatic way, just… you're there. In the shower, in bed at night, in the stupid little things that have nothing to do with you but somehow still are you. I don't even try to think about you, it just happens.

I keep finding your messages. I never deleted them. Sometimes I read them again even though I already know what they say. I don't know if I'll even send you this. Honestly probably not. I think I just needed to write it down somewhere.

I'm not doing this to bring anything back or ask you for anything. I just wanted to say thank you. For all of it — the good stuff, the bad stuff, the times it was just easy being around you. It all mattered to me, even the parts that hurt.

I guess I made this just so it doesn't disappear. Not for you, not really for anything. Just so the memory stays somewhere. Nothing more than that.

I hope you're doing good. I really do.

Mr. big A.
